trial_metadata.title: Dapagliflozin Effect on CardiovascuLAR Events — Thrombolysis In Myocardial Infarction 58 (DECLARE–TIMI 58)
trial_metadata.indication: Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus with established or high risk of atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease

source_refs.citation: Wiviott SD et al. Dapagliflozin and Cardiovascular Outcomes in Type 2 Diabetes. N Engl J Med. 2019;380(4):347-357.

_provenance.note: All metadata fields confirmed in public registry and primary publication.
Inclusion/exclusion criteria reproduced from public registry. Exact numeric thresholds confirmed in Wiviott NEJM 2019 methods.

inclusion.description: Age ≥ 40 years at time of informed consent

_provenance.note: Exact age cutoff confirmed in registry and publication.

inclusion.description: Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus with HbA1c ≥ 6.5% and ≤ 12.0% at screening

_provenance.note: HbA1c range 6.5–12.0% confirmed in registry.

inclusion.description: Established cardiovascular disease (prior MI, multi-vessel coronary artery disease, prior ischaemic stroke, or peripheral arterial disease) OR multiple cardiovascular risk factors (age ≥ 55 men / ≥ 60 women, plus dyslipidaemia, hypertension, or current smoker)

_provenance.source: ClinicalTrials.gov NCT01986881 — Inclusion Criterion 3 + Wiviott NEJM 2019 Methods
_provenance.note: Dual-population design (established CVD + high-risk) confirmed in primary publication.

inclusion.description: eGFR ≥ 60 mL/min/1.73 m² at screening (CKD-EPI formula)

_provenance.note: eGFR ≥ 60 confirmed in registry. CKD-EPI formula specified in protocol methods.
T1DM explicitly excluded in registry.

exclusion.description: Systemic corticosteroid use at screening (chronic, not short-course)

_provenance.note: Chronic corticosteroid exclusion confirmed in registry.

interventions.name: Dapagliflozin

_provenance.note: Exact dose tolerance not published. SGLT2 tablets are fixed-dose; zero tolerance is operationally correct but exact regulatory window is assumed.

interventions.duration: Until primary endpoint adjudication or study close

prohibited_combinations.name: Other SGLT2 inhibitors
prohibited_combinations.reason: Pharmacodynamic redundancy and unpredictable safety interaction; co-administration not evaluated in this study.

_provenance.note: Other SGLT2 inhibitors prohibited during study per registry.

prohibited_combinations.name: Loop diuretics (high-dose)
prohibited_combinations.reason: Risk of volume depletion and AKI when combined with SGLT2 inhibitor.

_provenance.note: High-dose loop diuretic caution is standard SGLT2 class labelling; specific prohibition threshold assumed for demo rule engine.

prohibited_combinations.name: Warfarin
prohibited_combinations.reason: Dapagliflozin may affect warfarin exposure via renal transport; INR monitoring complexity and interaction risk cited in labelling.

_provenance.note: Warfarin prohibition used as demo deviation scenario (matches root.md DEV-003/MED-007). Not explicitly listed in NCT01986881 registry; based on class-level drug interaction guidance.

prohibited_combinations.name: Insulin (new initiation during study)
prohibited_combinations.reason: New insulin initiation during study not permitted without Medical Monitor approval — would confound glycaemic endpoint.

_provenance.note: New insulin initiation restriction is a common Phase III T2D trial constraint; assumed for demo rule engine. Patients on insulin at baseline were enrolled.

protocol_constraints.description: Dapagliflozin 10 mg must be dispensed at the Randomisation visit (V-RAND) as the first dose.
severity_escalation_conditions: Patient in ARM-ACTIVE receives no drug at V-RAND → escalates to major (first dose missed)
protocol_constraints.source_text: Study drug will be dispensed to the patient at the randomisation visit. The first dose will be taken at the site.

_provenance.source: ClinicalTrials.gov NCT01986881 — Interventions: 10 mg dapagliflozin oral QD starting at randomisation
_provenance.note: Dose and route confirmed; exact first-dose-at-site language is standard Phase III convention.

protocol_constraints.description: Drug accountability compliance ≥ 70% at each annual assessment (pill count or electronic diary). Compliance < 70% triggers a protocol deviation.
severity_escalation_conditions: Compliance < 50% for any 3-month period → escalates to major
protocol_constraints.source_text: Protocol compliance will be assessed by pill count at each annual visit. Compliance < 70% should be documented as a protocol deviation.

_provenance.note: 70% compliance threshold is the standard Phase III drug compliance threshold; exact value not published for NCT01986881.

protocol_constraints.description: Dapagliflozin dose must be exactly 10 mg (one tablet). Any dose modification (splitting, doubling) constitutes a protocol deviation.
severity_escalation_conditions: Dose > 10 mg → pharmacodynamic overdose risk → major
Dose < 10 mg without documented Medical Monitor approval → major
protocol_constraints.source_text: The study drug dapagliflozin will be administered as a 10 mg tablet once daily. No dose modification is permitted.

_provenance.note: Fixed 10 mg dose confirmed in registry; zero tolerance is implicit in fixed-dose tablet design.

protocol_constraints.description: Screening visit must occur within 14 days before randomisation (Day -14 to Day 0).
severity_escalation_conditions: Screening > 30 days before randomisation → eligibility data may be stale → major
protocol_constraints.source_text: Screening procedures should be performed within 14 days prior to randomisation.

_provenance.note: 14-day screening window is standard for Phase III CVOT; exact window not published for NCT01986881.

protocol_constraints.description: Month 2 visit must occur between Day 53 and Day 67 (Day 60 ± 7 days).
protocol_constraints.source_text: The Month 2 visit should be scheduled approximately 2 months (±1 week) after randomisation.

_provenance.note: Day 60 ± 7 is a standard Month 2 window; exact window not published.

protocol_constraints.description: Month 6 safety visit must occur between Day 168 and Day 196 (Day 182 ± 14 days). This is a safety-critical visit.
severity_escalation_conditions: Missed entirely (no visit within window) → major (safety-critical visit)
protocol_constraints.source_text: The Month 6 safety assessment is mandatory. Sites should reschedule within the window if the visit is missed.

_provenance.source: SYNTHETIC (window) / SOURCE_DERIVED (visit is safety-critical from SGLT2 class monitoring requirements)
_provenance.note: SGLT2 inhibitor trials require regular renal safety monitoring. Month 6 as safety-critical is a class-level assumption.

protocol_constraints.description: Concurrent use of any other SGLT2 inhibitor (canagliflozin, empagliflozin, ertugliflozin) is prohibited for the duration of the study.
severity_escalation_conditions: Any SGLT2 combination use → major immediately
protocol_constraints.source_text: Concomitant use of other SGLT2 inhibitors is not permitted during the study.

_provenance.source: ClinicalTrials.gov NCT01986881 — Eligibility: exclusion of other SGLT2 inhibitors
_provenance.note: SGLT2 inhibitor class prohibition confirmed in registry.

protocol_constraints.description: Warfarin use during the study requires Medical Monitor notification and INR monitoring. Initiation of warfarin without documentation constitutes a protocol deviation.
severity_escalation_conditions: Warfarin initiated without Medical Monitor notification → major
protocol_constraints.source_text: Vitamin K antagonists should be used with caution. New initiation of warfarin requires Medical Monitor notification and weekly INR monitoring.

_provenance.note: Warfarin interaction is a class-level dapagliflozin concern (FDA label). Exact protocol language assumed for demo. Matches DEV-003/MED-007 in root.md.

protocol_constraints.description: HbA1c measurement must be present at Screening (V-SCREEN) to confirm eligibility criterion IC-02.
severity_escalation_conditions: Patient enrolled without screening HbA1c → major eligibility deviation
protocol_constraints.source_text: HbA1c must be measured at screening. Patients with HbA1c < 6.5% or > 12.0% are ineligible.

_provenance.note: HbA1c range 6.5–12.0% confirmed in registry.

protocol_constraints.description: eGFR (CKD-EPI) must be ≥ 60 mL/min/1.73 m² at Screening to confirm eligibility criterion IC-04.
severity_escalation_conditions: Patient enrolled with eGFR < 60 → major eligibility deviation (Matches ELIG DEV-006 in root.md)
protocol_constraints.source_text: Patients with eGFR < 60 mL/min/1.73 m² at screening are excluded from the study.

_provenance.note: eGFR ≥ 60 threshold confirmed in registry.

protocol_constraints.description: Re-consent must be obtained within 14 days of a protocol amendment becoming effective. Late re-consent is an administrative deviation; failure to re-consent is a major deviation.
severity_escalation_conditions: Re-consent > 30 days OR study procedures performed without re-consent → major
protocol_constraints.source_text: In the event of a protocol amendment, patients must re-sign the updated informed consent form within 14 days of the amendment effective date.

_provenance.source: SYNTHETIC (14-day window) / SOURCE_DERIVED (ICH E6(R2) GCP 4.8.2 re-consent requirement)
_provenance.note: 14-day re-consent window is a standard assumption; GCP re-consent requirement is SOURCE_DERIVED. Matches CONSENT-001/DEV-007 in root.md.

protocol_constraints.description: eCRF data entry must be completed within 5 business days of the visit date.
severity_escalation_conditions: > 10 business days for 3 consecutive visits → minor (trending)
Pattern of > 10-day lag across site → triggers site risk score increase
protocol_constraints.source_text: All data must be entered into the eCRF within 5 business days of the visit or procedure date.

_provenance.note: 5-business-day eCRF requirement is standard Phase III practice; exact value assumed. Matches DATA-002/DEV-010 in root.md.

protocol_constraints.description: Double-blind must be maintained throughout the study. Emergency unblinding requires Medical Monitor approval and must be documented within 24 hours.
severity_escalation_conditions: Unblinding without documented Medical Monitor approval → major immediately
protocol_constraints.source_text: The study is double-blind. Unblinding should only occur in emergency situations. All unblinding events must be reported to the Medical Monitor within 24 hours.

_provenance.note: Double-blind confirmed in registry. 24-hour reporting requirement is standard GCP practice.
